briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 intensify multi-agent race as compute bottlenecks tighten

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with frontier labs releasing iterative models weekly. Geopolitical tensions rise over export controls while safety concerns mount around agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with enhanced reasoning chains while Anthropic's Claude 4.5 leads in safety benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 challenge Western dominance in open-source performance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement targets agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units while Microsoft and Google announce $50B+ data center expansions. TSMC reports AI chip shortages persisting into Q4 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols become the decisive advantage in achieving AGI by 2028?
